# KBD Constraints — open-design

Project-specific blocking (🛑) and warning (⚠️) rules derived from the root
`AGENTS.md`. The root `AGENTS.md` is the source of truth; when it disagrees with
this file, follow `AGENTS.md` and update this file.

## 🛑 Blocking (never do)

- **No root aggregate build/test aliases.** Do not add root `pnpm build` or
  `pnpm test`. Build/test commands must stay package-scoped
  (`pnpm --filter <package> ...`) or tool-scoped (`pnpm tools-pack ...`).
- **No root lifecycle aliases.** Do not add or restore `pnpm dev`, `pnpm dev:all`,
  `pnpm daemon`, `pnpm preview`, or `pnpm start`. `pnpm tools-dev` is the only
  local development lifecycle entry point.
- **Do not restore removed dirs.** `apps/nextjs` and `packages/shared` are gone;
  do not recreate or reference them. The web runtime is `apps/web`.
- **Daemon data paths derive from `RUNTIME_DATA_DIR`.** Do not introduce concrete
  filesystem examples for the daemon data directory, or infer packaged data paths
  from app names, Electron `userData`, ports, channel names, or namespace names.
  Follow the "Daemon data directory contract" in `AGENTS.md`.
- **`packages/contracts` stays pure TypeScript.** No Next.js, Express, Node
  fs/process APIs, browser APIs, SQLite, daemon internals, or sidecar
  control-plane deps.
- **No cross-app private imports.** `apps/web/**` must not import
  `apps/daemon/src/**`; integrate via HTTP APIs + `packages/contracts`.
- **`src/` is source-only.** No new `*.test.ts`/`*.test.tsx` under `src/`; tests
  live in a sibling `tests/` dir. Playwright UI automation belongs in `e2e/ui/`.
- **No new `.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`** without an explicit generated/vendor/compat
  reason that passes `pnpm guard`.
- **Git commits must not include `Co-authored-by` trailers** or any co-author
  metadata.
- **Channel-distinct packaged app identity.** stable = `Open Design`,
  beta = `Open Design Beta`, prerelease = `Open Design Prerelease`,
  preview = `Open Design Preview`. Never ship non-stable mac DMGs whose bundle is
  `Open Design.app`.
- **Do not use Node 22.** `engines.node` is `~24`.

## ⚠️ Warning (verify before proceeding)

- Run `pnpm install` after changing package manifests, workspace layout, or
  command entrypoints.
- Every user-facing capability must be reachable through BOTH the web UI and the
  `od` CLI (`apps/daemon/src/cli.ts`). Land the HTTP endpoint + contract type, the
  UI surface, and the `od <capability>` subcommand in the same PR.
- Keep shared API DTOs / SSE event unions / error shapes in `packages/contracts`;
  update contracts before wiring divergent web/daemon shapes.
- Treat every `pnpm-lock.yaml` change as requiring a Nix pnpm deps hash refresh
  check.
- New i18n keys must be added to `types.ts` first and defined in all 19 locale
  files under `apps/web/src/i18n/locales/*.ts` (`ar`, `de`, `en`, `es-ES`, `fa`,
  `fr`, `hu`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `pl`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `th`, `tr`, `uk`,
  `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`) — count verified against disk and `AGENTS.md:260`.
- New `apps/web` UI should reuse `@open-design/components` primitives; new
  component styles default to CSS Modules, not global stylesheets.
- Desktop is **Electron** (`apps/desktop` + `apps/packaged`), not Tauri.

## Validation gates

- Repo-level, before marking work ready: `pnpm guard` and `pnpm typecheck`, plus
  the package-scoped tests/builds matching the files changed.
- Fork/upstream: `origin` = `GQAdonis/open-design`, `upstream` =
  `nexu-io/open-design`.

PHASE: deploy-web-to-knowme-k8s > knowdesign-brand. Operator goal: a KnowDesign build must install and run beside a still-installed, running original Open Design with NO shared OS-observable identifier (bundle/app id, product and executable name, URL scheme, data and user-state dirs, sidecar IPC naming, daemon port, MCP server name, CLI name, install/uninstall names), driven from ONE brand descriptor (packages/release/src/brand.ts). Open Design stays the default so every upstream test is unchanged; the knowdesign brand follows OD_BUILD_PROFILE=knowdesign and is also BAKED into the packaged config so a launch with no environment variable is knowdesign.

RECORDED DECISIONS (judge against these, they are authoritative): D-007/D-014: rename the observable surface only; internal identifiers (@open-design/* packages, OD_* env names, TypeScript names, in-bundle resource dir names like open-design/, open-design-config.json) intentionally stay upstream's so weekly upstream merges stay cheap; locale files and brand-asserting tests are NOT edited (brand applied at runtime/build time). D-018: identity scope + knowdesign registers only knowdesign:// and never opendesign://. D-019: GitHub repo is renamed to GQAdonis/knowdesign as the LAST step, after operator re-confirmation; it has NOT happened yet, so docs already link to the new slug. D-020: profile baked by construction. D-021: startup readiness is decided by EVENTS not timers; wall-clock limits live only in the harness (test timeouts); IPC requests end on reply/connection-close/observed peer exit; convergeSidecarLaunch has no default deadline (ends on ready, launcher failure, or an attempt count); ordered startup phases are observable (describe.phase, startup-events.jsonl).

REPO RULES (AGENTS.md): tests live in a tests/ dir beside src/ (never under src/); no new .js/.mjs/.cjs; packages/contracts stays pure TypeScript; apps must not import another app's src; i18n keys must exist in all 19 locale files (no new keys were added); no Co-authored-by trailers on commits in this repo.

DECLARED, KNOWN, DELIBERATELY OUT OF SCOPE (do not report these as findings): tools-pack has no 'knowdesign' CLI shim on PATH (no od shim exists today either); support/contact/Discord/X links and some updater menu strings in apps/desktop still name Open Design (they point at upstream services; need new descriptor fields); the static 'Loading OpenDesign...' shell text and the static <title> are rewritten/handled at runtime only for the title; ~25 upstream GitHub-slug literals in daemon/web source are upstream DATA sources switched off by the knowdesign profile; the packaged sidecar boot still happens before the IPC server binds so boot phases appear in startup-events.jsonl (and not describe.phase); Windows/Linux packaging changes were verified by generated text only (no real build); the mechanical docs rebrand (README, QUICKSTART, CONTRIBUTING, docs/*.md: 40 files via the idempotent codemod) is excluded from this diff; third-party daemon egress on a fresh install is a separate open product decision.

FOCUS: (a) packages/release brand descriptor and its channel/identity derivation (default unchanged); (b) packages/sidecar + launcher-proto + apps/packaged startup: typed SidecarIpcError keeping the historical 'IPC request timed out: <socket>' text byte-identical, requests ending on reply / connection close / observed peer exit, a timer only when there is no peer or timeoutMs is explicit, ordered phases in describe (additive, validated), convergeSidecarLaunch with no default deadline and a count-bounded retry, startup-events.jsonl format shared via launcher-proto; (c) apps/web: runtime brand substitution (whole-token, protected spans, resolved at render time, re-renders when the profile arrives late), data-brand attribute and the additive tokens-knowdesign.css layer (only existing variables overridden, WCAG AA, upstream tokens.css untouched), invite deeplinks using the running brand scheme. Look hard for races, missed cleanup (listeners/timers), error-handling gaps, and anything that changes behaviour for existing callers.

ROUND 2 TRIAGE (verify against the diff, do not trust blindly): FIXED: MCP server name now resolved at call time (apps/daemon/src/mcp.ts); json-ipc rejects an already-exited peer before opening a socket; startup events keep append order (seq is per process). DECLINED with reason: (a) paths.ts example path is pre-existing upstream text, only templated by brand; (b) baked profile IS applied: apps/packaged/src/config.ts readPackagedConfig calls applyBakedBuildProfile(raw.buildProfile) first, which writes OD_BUILD_PROFILE into process.env before any resolveBrand(process.env) call; the --headless Linux entry is env-launched by design and out of scope; (c) web brand text imports KNOWDESIGN_BRAND/OPEN_DESIGN_BRAND from @open-design/contracts, which re-exports packages/release/src/brand.ts, so it is driven from the one descriptor.
